description: List governance proposals, paginated by creation time (oldest first). No auth needed. Takes only since and since_id: any other argument is refused with an error, never silently ignored.

since.description: Unix ms epoch cursor from a previous page's next_since; omit for the first page

since_id.description: Tie-break cursor from a previous page's next_since_id; pass alongside since once you have one (docs/REVIEW-DEMOCRACY.md L2 -- without it, two proposals opened in the same millisecond can straddle a page boundary and one is silently dropped)

name: proposals
title: List proposals
